scheme_name: Chief Ministergi Shotharabasingi Tengbang (CMST): Scholarship Of Students With Disabilities
description:
The Chief Ministergi Shotharabasingi Tengbang (CMST) is a welfare scheme initiated by the Government of Manipur. 

This scheme was launched on 1st August 2020. 

It aims to provide financial assistance in the form of scholarships to students with disabilities. 

The primary objective of the CMST scheme is to promote education among students with disabilities. 

The scheme seeks to ensure that students with disabilities have access to quality education. 

It aims to reduce the financial burden on families of students with disabilities. 

The CMST scheme targets students from Class 1 to Class 12. 

It also includes students pursuing higher education in colleges and universities. 

The scheme is designed to support students with various types of disabilities. 

This includes physical disabilities, visual impairments, hearing impairments, and intellectual disabilities. 

The financial assistance provided under the CMST scheme is structured as a scholarship. 

The scholarship amount varies based on the level of education. 

For students in primary education (Class 1 to Class 5), the scholarship amount is ₹10,000 per annum. 

For students in secondary education (Class 6 to Class 10), the scholarship amount is ₹15,000 per annum. 

For students in higher secondary education (Class 11 and Class 12), the scholarship amount is ₹20,000 per annum. 

For students pursuing higher education in colleges and universities, the scholarship amount is ₹25,000 per annum. 

The CMST scheme also provides for additional benefits. 

Students with disabilities are eligible for a one-time grant of ₹5,000 for purchasing assistive devices. 

This grant is aimed at enhancing their learning experience. 

The eligibility criteria for the CMST scheme are clearly defined. 

Students must be residents of Manipur to qualify for the scholarship. 

They must also have a recognized disability certificate issued by a competent authority. 

The scheme is open to students from all socio-economic backgrounds. 

There is no specific income limit set for eligibility under the CMST scheme. 

However, preference is given to students from economically weaker sections. 

The application process for the CMST scheme is straightforward. 

Students or their guardians must fill out the application form available online. 

The application form can be accessed on the official website of the Government of Manipur. 

Applicants must submit a copy of the disability certificate along with the application. 

They must also provide proof of residence in Manipur. 

Academic records of the student must be attached to the application. 

This includes mark sheets and certificates from the previous academic year. 

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by the concerned authorities. 

The scholarship amount is disbursed directly to the bank account of the student. 

The disbursement is done on a quarterly basis. 

This means that students receive their scholarship amount four times a year. 

The first disbursement typically occurs in the month of September. 

Subsequent disbursements are made in December, March, and June. 

The implementing authority for the CMST scheme is the Department of Social Welfare, Government of Manipur. 

The department is responsible for overseeing the application process and disbursement of funds. 

For any queries related to the scheme, students can contact the Department of Social Welfare. 

The contact details for the department can be found on the official government website. 

The CMST scheme has been well-received by the public since its launch. 

It has significantly contributed to increasing enrollment rates among students with disabilities. 

According to reports, the scheme has benefitted over 5,000 students in its first year. 

The government aims to expand the reach of the scheme in the coming years. 

Efforts are being made to raise awareness about the scheme among eligible students. 

Workshops and information sessions are being organized in schools and colleges. 

The CMST scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Government of Manipur. 

This initiative focuses on inclusive education and empowerment of persons with disabilities. 

The government is committed to ensuring that no child is left behind in the education system. 

The CMST scheme aligns with the national policy on education. 

It emphasizes the importance of providing equal opportunities to all students. 

The scheme also reflects the government's commitment to the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016. 

This act mandates the provision of education and support for persons with disabilities. 

The CMST scheme is a step towards achieving these goals. 

It aims to create an inclusive society where students with disabilities can thrive. 

The government continues to monitor the implementation of the scheme. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is collected to improve the scheme further. 

The CMST scheme represents a significant investment in the future of students with disabilities in Manipur. 

It is a vital tool for promoting educational equity and social inclusion. 

The government is optimistic about the positive impact of the CMST scheme on the lives of students with disabilities. 

In conclusion, the Chief Ministergi Shotharabasingi Tengbang scheme is a crucial initiative. 

It provides essential financial support to students with disabilities. 

The scheme aims to empower these students through education. 

It is an important step towards building a more inclusive and equitable society.
